briefdescription.para: This function decodes and prints the last captured DRM / static-HDR InfoFrame (INFOFRAME SDP, type 0x87).

detaileddescription.para: The DRM InfoFrame arrives on the RX info-packet path (not the ext-packet path used by the VSC colorimetry SDP), and is captured by DpRxSs_InfoPacketHandler into hdr_if_frame[].
